what_is_excluded: Everything that is not an operative first-party statement of acceptance or refusal, bound to an ADMITTED census identity by the street identity the page itself states. one_identity_classified_once: The join is on street identity, so two brands at one address cannot both settle it: the census already withheld those buildings as a founder ruling, and a second read of an already-settled identity is reported DUPLICATE_READ_FOR_ONE_IDENTITY.
